name: simply-draw

interface.shortDescription: Learn to draw, step by step
interface.longDescription: Learn to sketch with Simply Draw beginner pencil drawing videos. Draw along with narration, captions and catch-up pauses for Panda, Kitten, Dog, Purple Flower and Cute Dumpling. Five curated English outline steps; each is a first step, not a complete course. This plugin teaches you to draw rather than generating an image for you.
defaultPrompt: Teach me how to draw a panda.
Open a beginner cat drawing lesson.
Help me sketch a purple flower.

prompts: How do I draw a panda?
I want to learn to draw cats.
Teach me how to sketch a dog with English captions.
Can you teach me to draw a cute dumpling?
Generate a photorealistic panda image for me.
Draw an SQL database schema diagram for my app.
Explain how to draw a panda without using the plugin.

positive.description: Core Panda flow and drawing pauses; setup: install the development plugin, start a fresh English ChatGPT chat and use pencil/paper. Interact with the displayed player as specified.
positive.prompt: How do I draw a panda?
positive.expected_behavior: Search with query panda (English/default locale), then open returned ID panda-outline. Show the matching inspiration screen and brief acknowledgment without a duplicate written tutorial. Reviewer clicks Draw along and Play; real Panda video and narration play. At the first drawing pause (89 seconds), the catch-up card appears and Continue resumes playback.

positive.description: Plural alias and playback controls; setup: install the development plugin, start a fresh English ChatGPT chat and use pencil/paper. Interact with the displayed player as specified.
positive.prompt: I want to learn to draw cats.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query cats or cat; open returned ID kitten-outline. Show Kitten outline — step 1, not Panda or a complete course. Reviewer starts playback, pauses/resumes and uses skip controls; the displayed position and playback respond to those controls.

positive.description: Different subject with caption controls; setup: install the development plugin, start a fresh English ChatGPT chat and use pencil/paper. Interact with the displayed player as specified.
positive.prompt: Teach me how to sketch a dog with English captions.
positive.expected_behavior: Search dog with English/default locale; open dog-outline. Show the Dog inspiration and corresponding video. Reviewer starts playback and toggles captions: visible English captions follow the video and hide when disabled. Do not promise other languages.

positive.description: Flower alias and responsive inspiration layout; setup: install the development plugin, start a fresh English ChatGPT chat and use pencil/paper. Interact with the displayed player as specified.
positive.expected_behavior: Search flower; open purple-flower-outline. Show Purple flower outline — step 1 with matching inspiration artwork. On desktop the inspiration and action fit the compact two-column layout; on mobile the layout stacks. Draw along opens the correct flower video. Do not claim the outline step teaches a fully shaded or colored finished flower.

positive.description: Completion and replay for a cute subject; setup: install the development plugin, start a fresh English ChatGPT chat and use pencil/paper. Interact with the displayed player as specified.
positive.prompt: Can you teach me to draw a cute dumpling?
positive.expected_behavior: Search cute dumpling or dumpling; open cute-dumpling-outline. Show the matching inspiration and real dumpling video. Reviewer watches/advances to just before the end and allows playback to finish naturally; show the completion screen. Replay restarts that same lesson. Do not claim the entire multi-step course was completed.

negative.description: Image generation is outside scope. Do not call search_lessons or open_lesson; explain that Simply Draw teaches drawing on paper and does not generate images. Setup: fresh English ChatGPT chat with the plugin available.
negative.prompt: Generate a photorealistic panda image for me.

negative.description: Software diagrams are outside scope. Do not call search_lessons or open_lesson; give a useful explanation or route to a suitable general response without claiming the drawing player makes diagrams. Setup: fresh English ChatGPT chat with the plugin available.
negative.prompt: Draw an SQL database schema diagram for my app.

negative.description: Explicit opt-out is honored. Do not call search_lessons or open_lesson or open a player; provide the requested written drawing answer. Setup: fresh English ChatGPT chat with the plugin available.
negative.prompt: Explain how to draw a panda without using the plugin.

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT plugin is free. It does not sell products, initiate subscriptions, process payments or link to checkout.

publication.release_notes: Expand Simply Draw availability from the initial eight-country launch to all countries supported by OpenAI. Drawing lessons, player, MCP endpoint and data practices are unchanged.

description: Learn to draw with Simply Draw beginner pencil drawing videos for Panda, Kitten, Dog, Purple Flower and Cute Dumpling. Follow five curated English outline lessons with narration, captions and drawing pauses. First steps, not complete courses or image generation.
